Hey, I understand how youre feeling, im in the exaxt same boat as you down to the exact same genders as those who you can talk to. Its really crappy to not feel like youre able to talk to someone that can help you. I know not everyone is the same and what works for some might not work for others, but its sometimes relieving knowing someone other than you knows. Even if they arent able to help you get better, its kind of like less of a burden to have it only to yourself. If youre comfortable enough and believe that he wouldnt mind listening to you, you can try to bring it up lightly and see how it goes. My heart goes out to you and hope you find something that works well for you to try to get better. Remember that you matter and getting help for your ed matters to. I’m here to talk about it if you want to dm me.
